content.short: Hashstack provides permissionless under-collateralized loans for personal and trading capital needs.
content.description: DeFi lending today is largely over-collateralized, with borrowers posting collateral that exceeds the loan value by about 42%. This creates a mismatch between need and loan and can drive borrowers toward higher APRs. Hashstack provides permissionless under-collateralized loans of up to 300% of the borrower’s collateral, designed for personal and trading capital needs without added risk to liquidity providers, borrowers, or the protocol. As a wallet’s relationship with the protocol grows, the amount that can be borrowed increases up to 300% LTV. The debt can be spent in two ways: fully as trading capital, or by withdrawing up to 70% of the collateral into the wallet for personal use, while keeping the remaining debt for trading. The protocol retains ownership of the debt, while the borrower is given the right to spend. To enable effective loan spend as trading capital, Hashstack curates the dApps, supported assets, and actions.
